value: Walnut consumption decreased feelings of hunger and appetite assessed using visual analog scales and increased the activation of the right insula to highly desirable food cues.
Our key finding is increased activation of the right insula following five-day walnut consumption to highly desirable (e.g. high fat or high calorie) food cues amongst obese patients.
